admission.justification: A named path that does not exist makes a reader's command or edit fail; the check judges every named path that no other check owns.

applicability: Every public document that names a repository path in prose or a code span.
conditions: The named path is not Git-ignored.
The path is not under mcp/src/agents_remember/ or skills/, which the instruction consistency test owns.
exclusions: Paths Git ignores, which are build products.
Paths owned by the instruction consistency test.
statement: A repository path that a public document names exists in the tree, unless Git ignores it or the instruction consistency test owns it.
